digest.component_or_area: plan review signing and manifest generation
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit one deterministic plan-material pin per direct child and per direct prerequisite, identified by canonical ticket ID and containing the target's 16-hex material fingerprint.

Plan-material pins must appear in the deterministic manifest after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, sorted lexicographically by role (child before prerequisite) then by canonical ID, with duplicate edges within each role collapsed.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload the full store-wide ticket_states_by_id including archived states, collect outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks without active-source filtering, and resolve aliases and prefixes before deduplication.

Every unreadable or unresolvable target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with a named PlanRelationSnapshotError reason (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure) before any LLM evaluation.

tracker_head_sha() must verify the tickets tracker is clean (status --porcelain and ls-files -u have no output) and return the 40-hex SHA from rev-parse HEAD, raising store-read-failure for any git, IO, path, or output errors.

All plan-review signing paths (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass the complete related_material pin set to build_manifest, and legacy manifests without pins must remain parseable.
